notes: Assembled from the Edition 4.1 PDF via pdftotext -layout. Source used is a university mirror PDF (DePaul); the original Savannah c-tutorial Texinfo source was not used because the mirror PDF is the copy whose copyright page was verified. Excluded: Table of Contents (which sits at the end of this PDF, pp. i-viii), Code index and Concept index. Running heads (chapter/section title + page number) and standalone page numbers stripped; 3+ blank lines collapsed. Caveats, all faithful to the source itself: Appendix G (Answers to questions), Bibliography and Glossary are literally 'Blah blah blah.' stubs in Edition 4.1; Appendix B also opens with a 'Blah blah blah.' line before its real content. 'Bits and pieces' is an unnumbered section that appears after the indexes in the PDF's own page order; it is included after Glossary. A note in another hosted copy of Edition 4.1 states the tutorial is no longer promoted by the GNU Project as of 2003; the licence is unaffected. GFDL was not in the fetcher's earlier allowed list (mini_ai/data_fetch.py); this file was assembled manually after verifying the licence from the document's own copyright page.
